notes.title: 🔥 Sharing the Development Progress of **AZ Renovation**
notes.notes: [p]Stalkers! [/p][p]We’re continuing our work on the new **AZ Renovation** server and want to share a few highlights of what we’ve been working on. In fact, there’s much more — but here are just some examples.[/p][h2]### 🛒 Traders[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/6fe1a00ee22645a9da31fd7e210ab2b99010b070.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]* Certain trader items now require meeting specific conditions before they can be purchased.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/bde2c00aeb5ce325c592c86642c054c7453bc868.jpg"][/img][/p][p]* Items with **unlimited stock** are marked with a special icon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/246e17634af69d0916c983b199013d5559faf5ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p]* All items for **gold rubles** are now available from any NPC trader under a separate **“Gold”** tab.[/p][p][/p][h2]📦 Inventory & Storage[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/898d78edc99f01a7bbddc0d7876e5acf1d1d1ef3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/99606a5080f63173e46ccf6f2f443696b05868bd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]* Window sizes can now be adjusted — from 4×5 up to 10×10 slots.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Item Modifications[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/99c85a9384cc9d11682928fbec968b69b8f384ee.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/1263c2882875b82f0cc16d5c4129e9ce644a454e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]* The modification system has been improved (initially for artifacts only).[/p][p]* A new option allows you to **increase the chance of successful modification** using a special item.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔄 NPC Barter[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/f0a47eb6a5b867162f6ce57a9e1e8db5487fd05f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]* The barter interface has been upgraded:[/p][p]  * new **“Hide Unavailable”** feature;[/p][p]  * auto-fill;[/p][p]  * optimized loading of barter lists at NPCs.[/p][p]⚠️ **Please note:** all these updates apply **only to the new AZ Renovation server**![/p][p][/p][p]This is just a small part of what’s already done and still in progress — soon we’ll share more about other gameplay features awaiting you on the new server.[/p][p]The launch date for the new server will be announced soon! Stay tuned and turn on community notifications![/p]

notes.title: Fan Art contest: Results
notes.notes: [p]We’ve summed up the results of the [b]Fan Art Contest[/b]! We were pleasantly surprised by the number of participants. There were so many beautiful works created with heart and soul that it was difficult to choose only three. But we did it! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/a78b96257aea4dfda9b952510b447243d17b83c4.png"][/img][/p][p]---  [b]1st Place[/b] — Prize: [b]10,000 gold + UPS-1 Crate[/b] [b]Author:[/b] Professor Grinwood — [url="https://vk.com/pofessor_grinwood"]VK link[/url] [/p][p][b]Title:[/b] [i]Meeting Point — The Lighthouse[/i] [/p][p][b]Idea:[/b] An experienced stalker, known for his caution and ability to survive in the harshest conditions, arrives at the lighthouse, waiting for a guide. This lighthouse is one of the few places where contact with the outside world still remains, but it is also a magnet for anomalies and mutants. [/p][p][b]Inspiration:[/b] A bleak, snow-covered lighthouse where a veteran stalker awaits his guide. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/b209b7682eb313dc13c6b21233fe822da45f0267.png"][/img][/p][p]---  [b]2nd Place[/b] — Prize: [b]8,000 gold + UPS-1 Crate[/b] [/p][p][b]Author:[/b] Fadis Gazizov — [url="https://vk.com/idmupage"]VK link[/url] [/p][p][b]Title:[/b] [i]The Mythical Klondike[/i] [/p][p][b]Idea:[/b] One stalker finally discovers the Klondike, but the Zone never gives away its treasures for free. A Blowout is approaching—will the Klondike survive, or will the stalker have to search for riches elsewhere? [b]Inspiration:[/b] Every stalker dreams of finding an artifact field (a Klondike)—whether for wealth or salvation, it doesn’t matter. In the end, he will only receive what the Zone decides to grant him. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/4bfd7f2baba08490a6b53bf9b81687701df19e2b.png"][/img][/p][p]---  [b]3rd Place[/b] — Prize: [b]6,000 gold + “Raven” Pack \[from Battle Pass][/b] [/p][p][b]Author:[/b] Dima Fedorov — [url="https://vk.com/azamat39992"]VK link[/url] [/p][p][b]Title:[/b] [i]Tunguska, the Village of “Radius”[/i] [/p][p][b]Idea:[/b] A settlement for stalkers where they can rest, share stories of their adventures, discuss anomalies, and prepare for new expeditions. [/p][p][b]Inspiration:[/b] An old, atmospheric settlement in the heart of Tunguska, reachable only with the help of a guide. [/p][p][/p][p]---  Huge thanks to everyone who took part in the contest and for your love of the project![/p]

notes.title: Important notice
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/115388322796844c75cc501c6ac2e79fff87130e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Stalkers![/p][p]Starting [b]September 1[/b], Federal Law No. 282-FZ of **31.07.2025**, as well as new articles of the Russian Criminal Code (for example, Article 274.4), will come into effect. These introduce penalties for organizing the transfer of SIM cards and personal data to third parties for account access.[/p][p][/p][p]In this regard, we remind you that the **[b]transfer/sale of game accounts[/b]**, which has always been prohibited by the User Agreement and was done at one’s own risk, will now be actively punished.[/p][p][/p][p]All tickets of the type *“[b]I was given an account 10 years ago, and now I can’t log in[/b]”* will be closed without response.[/p][p][/p][p]⚖️ We follow the law — let’s play fair![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Work-in-Progress: Graphics Update & Optimization
notes.notes: [p]Hey Stalkers! We’ve been hard at work polishing the graphics and making the game run smoother — here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming.  [/p][h2][b]Visual upgrades:[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]dynamic shadows[/b] for a more immersive atmosphere.,[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]HDR[/b], bringing richer colors, deeper contrasts, and a more natural, eye-friendly look.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/b24cfecf3bfe5240bc3805baf17e1cee766eaac3.png"][/img][/p][h2]  [b]Performance optimization:[/b] [/h2][p]Right now, even objects you [i]can’t[/i] see (hidden behind walls or obstacles) are still rendered in the background — adding unnecessary load to the system. We’re implementing an [b]optimized rendering system[/b] that cuts off everything outside your field of view, making the game run faster and smoother.  [b]Screenshots:[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]First-person view,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/e59c5edc2e3b0c561d7d09b4cf95e92f3733bca3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Side view – current rendering,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/8a24cf738b53135e1de3601015d7cce6079a39a5.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Side view – optimized rendering,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/eaae5c01c9c8adc7bf19454a064e25c3ebe1134a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][p] Stay tuned — this is just one step in making the Zone both more beautiful [i]and[/i] more stable.[/p]

notes.title: New Server Coming!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/8699b2f1a8e8a0f7667a26031bc271e0fd1d3abc.png"][/img][/p][p]**Stalkers!**[/p][p]We've taken the best elements from previous versions of the game, added some quality-of-life improvements — and now we’re ready to present:[/p][p]**A-Zone Renovation** server overview.[/p][p]**What can you expect on this server?**[/p][p]---[/p][p]### 🎛 Interface[/p][p]* Brand-new character menu: modern, more informative, and easier to use.[/p][p]* The green health bar has been replaced with a more familiar red one.[/p][p]* Added customization to resize your storage, trade, and inventory windows individually — up to **10x10** grid squares.[/p][p]---[/p][p]### ⚙️ Gameplay[/p][p]* The leveling system has been reworked. It’s now based on the pre-wipe concept:[/p][p]  Max **Health** is 300 units, and **Stamina** is 400 units.[/p][p]* Partial rebalance of weapons, armor, and backpack weight.[/p][p]* Anomalies now activate when players approach or throw a rock near them.[/p][p]* The **Sporosis** disease and all related effects have been completely removed from the game.[/p][p]---[/p][p]### 🧭 NPCs & Factions[/p][p]* All guide prices have been revised. Some guides have been relocated in the **Caravan/Sorry Lakes** area, which now has only **two exits**.[/p][p]* A new guide has been added for the **Military** faction — leading to the Scientists in the **Vesuvius** location.[/p][p]* Daily quests are now available for every faction.[/p][p]* Reputation gains from quests have been rebalanced.[/p][p]---[/p][p]### 💎 Artifacts[/p][p]* Artifact prices have been reworked — most are now more valuable.[/p][p]* The charge extraction system has been reimagined as **awakening**. Awakened artifacts can be worn on your belt and offer stronger, longer-lasting effects. They're also more desirable in trades.[/p][p]* New containers of various sizes have been added for artifact storage — preserving freshness and preventing loss.[/p][p]* A new artifact will drop in the **Caravan/Sorry Lakes** area and will be used in trading for gear that protects against anomalies.[/p][p]---[/p][p]### 💰 Economy[/p][p]* We've completely removed timed items. All weapons, armor, and attachments are now **permanent**.[/p][p]* A shared account balance of golden rubles is now used across all characters.[/p][p]* All merchant prices have been reviewed and adjusted.[/p][p]* Sell prices to traders (artifacts, mutant parts, weapon parts) have been rebalanced.[/p][p]* Quest rewards have been partially reworked — including money, experience, and items.[/p][p]* Repair prices and equipment restoration have been revised.[/p][p]* Most item exchanges (including those from the Bookmaker) have been updated.[/p][p]---[/p][p]### 🛒 Donations[/p][p]* The **donation shop** (special item traders) has been removed. Some of their items have been distributed among regular NPC vendors and added to special trade tabs.[/p][p]* **Level 5 weapons** have been removed from the donation store and are now only obtainable through exchange with an NPC.[/p][p]* Some donation bases have been converted into fortified outposts — for example, in the **Lubech Area** (squares H4, З5, K8) — or public campfires (squares E3, O3).[/p][p]* Diaries, boosters, and experience tablets have been replaced by a **premium subscription**.[/p][p]---[/p][p]📸 **Note**: Screenshots are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent the final interface![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/a189e01dfb271920aa9716689537b69b35e1a3f1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/97a99e962bf7757ef6dee09007a4709d40c9c301.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/0244317097f4018947910fc5089837655b8aa38a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/657ae76e4de2dc349bd994c0830f68fba0d5a3dd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3462e32217162c2182b1ebb7252d11f6e34bef47.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/8c05581b3dae1b3c1ea88a7aab99917469be4ec5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/cc5e032265ed69694be520a62fe3092b39c873c3.png"][/img][/p]

[b]Stalkers![/b]
The Zone is not only dangerous — it's also stunningly beautiful.
That’s why we’re launching the

🎨 [b]ANOMALY ZONE FAN ART CONTEST[/b]

---

📜 [b]FAN ART CONTEST RULES[/b]


    [b]General terms:[/b]

- Only [b]original fan art[/b] created specifically for this contest will be accepted.
- All formats are welcome: digital painting, traditional art (scanned or photographed), 3D art, or collage.
- [b]Theme:[/b] The Beauty of the Zone through the Eyes of a Stalker.
- Submission deadline: [b]end of day, August 24 (MSK)[/b].
- Submit your work in [b]one [/b]of the following threads:

  VKontakte: [[url=https://vk.com/topic-16130329\_54265414](https://vk.com/topic-16130329_54265414]https://vk.com/topic-16130329\_54265414](https://vk.com/topic-16130329_54265414[/url])

  Steam Community: [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1157250/discussions/0/601910715107878294/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1157250/discussions/0/601910715107878294/[/url]]
 
   No need to post in both — just choose one platform.

The results of the contest will be published no later than [b]end of day, August 31 (MSK)[/b]. The developers' jury will determine the winners.


    [b]Submission format:[/b]

- File format: [b]JPG or PNG[/b], max size [b]10 MB[/b].
- If your file is larger, upload a resized version and provide a link to the original (Google Drive / Dropbox / Yandex.Disk).

Please include:

 - [b]Title of your artwork[/b]
 - Short description (idea, inspiration, etc.)


    [b]Originality requirements:[/b]

- The work must be [b]created by the participant[/b] and not submitted to any other contests.
- Tracing, copying, or modifying other people’s work is not allowed.
- Using [b]references [/b](for poses, lighting, weapons, etc.) is permitted — but do not replicate 1:1.


    [b]The moderators may request:[/b]

If needed, the participant must provide the following upon request:

  - [b]WIPs (Work in Progress) [/b]— at least [b]two intermediate screenshots[/b] showing the creative process;
  - [b]Source file [/b](PSD, Procreate, Krita, etc.) — if available;
  - [b]Reference sources[/b], if any were used.

> ❗ Failure to provide WIPs or suspicion of plagiarism may result in [b]immediate disqualification without explanation[/b].


    [b]Usage of submitted works:[/b]

- By entering the contest, participants agree that their artwork may be published on social media, the official website, and other project materials, with proper credit to the author.


    [b]Prizes:[/b]

🏆 [b]1st place[/b]: 10,000 gold + UPS-1 Case
🥈 [b]2nd place[/b]: 8,000 gold + UPS-1 Case
🥉 [b]3rd place[/b]: 6,000 gold + “Raven” Kit \[from the Battle Pass]


    [b]Additional notes:[/b]

- Submissions containing hate speech, forbidden symbols, or violations of Russian law will be removed.
- Each participant may submit [b]no more than one[/b] entry.

notes.title: Q & A
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3a92272a682aeaf8c75d1ca8ff5d5ea41a574b49.jpg"][/img]

Stalkers! Towards the end of June, as we promised, we gathered all the questions you asked since the last Q&A session and answered them. 

Feel free to ask more questions in our Discord: 
[url=https://discord.com/channels/1264106152124354630/1329067802304188448]https://discord.com/channels/1264106152124354630/1329067802304188448[/url] 

or in VK: 
[url=https://vk.com/topic-16130329_53597583]https://vk.com/topic-16130329_53597583[/url]

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Are you planning to upgrade the client from DirectX 9 to DirectX 11 or 12? That would reduce CPU load by shifting it to the GPU, allow modern shaders, and improve graphics.[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Yes, we plan to migrate to a more modern DirectX, but will do so gradually to maintain stability and compatibility. We’ve broken this into four key stages:

	• Transition to an improved engine with deferred rendering — enabling visual enhancements without performance loss.
	• Rework of all 3D models for physically based rendering (PBR), improving material and lighting realism.
	• Full implementation of PBR and 2024 graphical improvements, including optimizations.
	• Final move to DirectX 11 with modern shaders and balanced CPU/GPU load.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Will UI scaling be reworked for high resolutions? In 4K, UI elements are too tiny.[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Work on that has begun. We already have an experimental UI scaling prototype with encouraging results. We’ll first test it in the Battle Pass interface on RU servers, and if stable, roll it out gradually to the rest of the UI.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Will the fog that impacts visibility be reworked?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Yes, partially. We’ll leave “soft” fog as is, but plan to remove sprite-based fog entirely.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Is there a plan to bring back first-person jumping?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Not currently prioritized. Our mechanics are third-person focused, so switching now would be inefficient. However, it might be offered as an optional feature in the future.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]When will the anti-cheat work properly? It now appears active, but doesn’t yield results.[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Soon. It depends on companion services currently under active development.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Will the starter zone be fixed? Many NPCs are non-functional and new players struggle with onboarding.[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
It’s a complex task that requires time. It’s on our priority list, but we haven’t allocated time yet. We continue to address map bugs and shortcomings.

---

[u][b]Question: [/b][/u]
[b]Can tunnel access at the Dam be made available without clan restriction? Or can the loot/activity be moved to a neutral area for solo players?[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
We’re researching this issue, collecting analytics and data. We’ll make a decision once we have enough information.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Will new artifacts and resources be added (similar to K.VSS) for trade for unique weapons and armor?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Yes, we've been gradually updating all exchange mechanics and will continue to do so. Stay tuned!

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Are changes planned for the in-game economy, especially the silver currency? For example, price recalibration or additional silver for selling new artifacts?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Yes. This is a high-priority task, and changes will be implemented gradually.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Will professions be reworked? Currently only 2–3 are viable, the rest are considered worthless.[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
It’s planned, but not an immediate priority.

---

[u][b]Question: [/b][/u]
[b]Will equipping two primary weapons at once be possible?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
It is being considered, but not a priority at the moment.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]When will the promised clan progression system be added? It’s missing from the roadmap.[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
It’s planned, but not in the near-term priorities.

---

[u][b]Question: [/b][/u]
[b]Will the Battle Pass mechanics be modified? Progress is often abused by macros.[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
The Battle Pass isn't a competition, but abuse is tracked and punished. We’ll include some system updates in upcoming patches.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]When will bugs with radiation sound, "drip" sounds, and the infamous "chvak-chvak" be fixed? They’ve persisted for multiple updates.[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
We’re aware of these audio anomalies, but haven’t been able to reproduce them consistently, making them hard to fix. We suspect the “chvak” is a footstep sound on uneven surfaces. Once we find a reliable reproduction method, we’ll work on a fix.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]When will anomalies that disappear at certain camera angles or hide in bushes be fixed?[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
That fix is planned, but not currently prioritized.

---

[u][b]Question: [/b][/u]
[b]In the Kolya Tesla quest "New Repairs, Distant Frontier," there is no generator at the radio tower — will this be resolved?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
Yes. It will be fixed in the next patch or hotfix; work is already underway.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Are custom on-screen scopes allowed? Could using them result in a ban?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
They might cause a ban depending on how they are implemented. Contact support and we’ll review each case manually.

---

[u][b]Question:[/b][/u] 
[b]Can the "Positive" artifact quest be reinstated with a 6 day cooldown and no stacking with Premium, so non-Premium players can progress on weekends?[/b]

[u][b]Answer:[/b][/u] 
No, we don’t plan to bring that back.

---

[u][b]Question: [/b][/u]
[b]Will PvE and non-base resource/artifact farming be made more significant?[/b]

[u][b]Answer: [/b][/u]
Yes. We are committed to expanding PvE mechanics across various game aspects.

Stalkers!

Tomorrow, 12.06.25, the patch will be installed on all servers, from 07:00 to 11:00 (MSK).

[b]Battle Pass - "Echoes of Legend: Scar the Mercenary"[/b]

New battle pass has been added, containing:

- Backpack "Mercenary"
- Exoskeleton "Mercenary"

Exoskeleton "Mercenary" - an analogue of modified clan armor.
Backpack "Mercenary" increases the carried weight by 45 kilograms.
This backpack is a portable battery for the exoskeleton "Mercenary".
To charge the backpack, you need the "Honey" Charged Block.
When you put on the exoskeleton and the charged backpack, the effect "Explosion protection" is applied, which increases protection from explosion by 180 units and additionally increases the carried weight by 100 kilograms. The buff lasts for 2 hours.

[b]Attention![/b]
The "Mercenary" exoskeleton cannot be equipped with the "Dark Stalker" backpack at the same time!

This battle pass contains pleasant intermediate rewards that will help in the development of your character:
First Set for Clan' Equipment Mod, Cynologist Suit, "Abakan" Assault Rifle, USO Suit and the "Swift" Pistol.

The new battle pass case has been supplemented with the UPS-1 set, similar in characteristics to the SBZ set.

The number of coupons for exchange at the NPC "Mysterious Huckster" has been changed, and he has also been given the opportunity to exchange parts of the "Raven" set, which will be available until 13.07.25.

---

[b]New season of "Clan Ranking"[/b]

The new season has added an updated "Winner" case with the SR-3M assault rifle.

Advantages: SR-3M assault rifle has an extended magazine for 40 rounds for the 9x39 caliber, as well as good damage, exceeding the damage of the AEK-762 assault rifle.

The "Winner" case, containing the "Pecheneg" Machine Gun, will be available until 26.06.25.

In the future, we do not rule out its return.

notes.title: Macros no longer allowed in game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/b76e179bdb2475a53a2187fa6ba5b35ab8bd418f.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

For a long time, macros were not prohibited in the game, except those affecting shooting mechanics.
However, we have received numerous complaints from players about widespread abuse of battle pass mechanics using macros.
As a result, we have decided to ban all macros in the game — including those used for item pickup, pet summoning, and other actions. This includes programmable keyboards, mice, other hardware, and any software-based solutions.
From the moment this announcement is published, the use of any macros in the game will be considered a punishable offense.

We wish everyone fair and enjoyable gameplay!

notes.title: Game update coming tomorrow
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/4f4aa08acddff71167bec25ef97e040f53b04f8c.jpg[/img]

Tomorrow a patch will be installed to all servers.

* Arena victories are now rewarded with Arena Champion Coupons (limit — 50 per day). These can be exchanged with the Bookmaker for weapons and useful buffs (see below).

[b]Buffs similar to clan base buffs have been added. Their effects are approximately 70% of the base buffs and do not stack with them.[/b]
  Buffs can be exchanged with the Bookmaker NPC for Arena Champion Coupons:

  * "Chunky" Cocktail: +40 bullet resistance — 35 Coupons
  * "Master" Cocktail: +150 explosion resistance, +40 health — 40 Coupons
  * Morphine Shot: +6 HP/sec, removes intoxication — 40 Coupons
  * "Sprinter" Cocktail: +14 stamina regeneration — 30 Coupons
    Available at the Workbench:
  * "Jaeger" Cocktail: +60 melee damage resistance
  * Herbal Brew: +40 melee damage resistance
  * "Hercules": +40 kg carry weight
  * "Tonic": +20 kg carry weight
    All of the above items are *non-personal* — they can be traded or sold to other players for silver.

[b]The following weapons and attachments are also available from the Bookmaker for Arena Champion Coupons:[/b]

  * FN F2000 Assault Rifle — 3000 Coupons
  * Taurus Hunter 460 Revolver — 2000 Coupons
  * M110 Sniper Rifle — 2000 Coupons
  * FN F2000 Underbarrel Grenade Launcher — 500 Coupons
  * Taurus Hunter Optical Sight — 800 Coupons
  All of the above weapons can be restored.

[b]A Premium Subscription has been added (available for 30, 90, 180, or 360 days):[/b]

  * x2 silver from quests and x2 experience from killing mutants and completing quests
  * 40% discount on repairs from NPCs
  * 50% discount on guide/fast-travel services
  * +20% silver when selling artifacts and mutant parts to the trader
  * Buying a 180-day subscription gives 1 Premium Coupon; a 360-day subscription gives 2. These can be exchanged with the Bookmaker for attachments or paint kits
  * XP Pills, Journals, and Spark no longer give bonus experience. As compensation, all players will automatically receive 10 days of Premium upon first login after the update
  * All Premium Subscriptions are tradable items — they can be given or sold to other players for silver.
ATTENTION! After purchasing the Premium Subscription item, be it from the store or from other players, you must ACTIVATE it by right-clicking on it. The Premium will not work unless activated.

* Reward suits available from the Bookmaker for Premium Fighter Coupons have been revised. Their stats match the KB-M2 suit (30-day version):

  * "Kid" Suit
  * "Horse" Suit
  * "Ghillie" Suit
  * "Predator" Suit

* Free fast-travel has been removed from the "Chem Burial Site" base. Instead, 100 units of gasoline are now provided daily

* The weight buff at "The Mine" Settlement base has been reduced from 100 kg to 60 kg

* Health and stamina indicators have been fixed and expanded; a premium icon has been added

* New quests for premium bolts are available from the NPC "Trader"

* Fixed several issues linked to client crashes

* Character menu redesigned

notes.title: Project Roadmap: “Anomaly Zone”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/b42f84e0d210fc662d36960c9495fc9187c0ea0a.jpg[/img]

Project Roadmap: “Anomaly Zone”
For the coming months
This document outlines our key plans — what will be changed, improved, and added to the game.
We don’t promise strict deadlines, but we are focused on sustainable development — without rollbacks or temporary fixes.

Key Objectives (Top Priority)

1. In-Game Economy and Market
   We are launching a full-fledged player trading system via a trading board instead of sitting NPCs. Exchanges, buyback prices, guide services, and ammo trader prices will be reworked. This will be done step by step, with analysis and adjustments after each phase.

2. Balance, Bugs, Lags
   Improving gameplay and eliminating critical bugs is a constant effort. We know how important this is to the overall experience, so these fixes — from reload lags to server instability — are being made continuously. Weapon and armor rebalance will also be carried out gradually, based on data and statistics.

3. Platform Updates
   Migration to modern DirectX versions. Physics updates. All platform improvements will run in parallel in the background.

4. PvE Mechanics Expansion
   It’s no secret that the current state of the game leans heavily toward PvP players and factions. One of our top priorities is rebalancing this and introducing meaningful content for solo players and newcomers.

5. Anti-Cheat
   A fair game is the foundation of trust. We will continue to improve anti-cheat systems across all servers.

6. A NEW SERVER is being prepared for launch.
   It’s not a “Reborn” or “Old” — it’s a full relaunch of the project and a chance for everyone to start fresh. Some improvements will be introduced gradually through patches.

What to Know About the New Server:

* It will launch on a 64-bit base from the start
* It will feature an improved built-in anti-cheat system
* It will receive ongoing updates alongside existing servers
* Existing servers will remain active and continue to receive updates
* Flag capture mechanics and respawns at temporary campfires will be reworked
* The donation system will be restarted. The roulette and time-limited donation items will be removed. Some formerly time-limited items will become available for gold currency. Top-tier gear will be obtained through gameplay via exchanges. Basic gear will be available for silver.
* Experience pills, journals, and other “pay-to-win” mechanics will be removed. M2 weapons, clan-exclusive gear and armor will also be phased out.

Mid-Term Objectives (Second Priority)

1. Entry and Registration
   These processes will be simplified, lowering the barrier to entry and preparing for the influx of new players.

2. Player-to-Player Trading
   Item and currency exchange between players will be introduced as a continuation of the market reform.

Deferred but Not Forgotten (Long-Term Outlook)

1. Tutorials and Starting Zone
   Newcomers deserve a clear and welcoming start. However, investing time and resources here will only be effective once the online player base and economic systems are stable.

2. Website and UI
   The visual appearance of the project — from the landing page to in-game interfaces — will be improved.

FINAL PRINCIPLE
First — foundation: fairness, stability, economy
Then — convenience: onboarding, exchanges, growth
Finally — polish: website, tutorials
All of this will be implemented step by step. No rush, no rollbacks.
Thank you to everyone who’s with us — and to those not playing yet, but still following the project.

notes.title: The First Beat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/f7b907a3fd085c2fc5fce6fa9f0383a7e87cb2dc.png[/img]
The sky over the Zone was getting lighter, the dawn lazily seeping through the matte glass of the eternal haze.
Just like always, anomalies were pulsating and the Broken Screen proudly popping near the railway station.
Yet something was slightly off. Very few noticed it.
The polar bear at Terra Nova stirred in its den after a good dinner.
A rat near the Piper hissed and bristled up.
Vasilisa the Beautiful looked away from the mirror for a moment, raising her perfectly made-up eyebrow.

For very very far away, yet unseen and unheard, came the first impulse.
The first beat.

notes.title: Weekly PvE event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/347677890a3b3a7e42bce47cfc4e72110272cf88.jpg[/img]
Stalkers!

The event where you have to kill 2000/800/400 mutants of certain types in batches of 500/200/100, is now weekly and repeats every weekend with no additional announcement. If we launch it during some holidays, we will announce it separately.
We also expanded the list of mutants.

Every weekend, from beginning of day on Saturday (12.01 am) till end of day on Sunday (11.59 pm) Moscow time, kill the following mutants:

Pups/Dogs - 2000 total, in batches of 500
Brownies/Hobgoblins - 2000 total, in batches of 500
Spiders/small spiders - 2000 total, in batches of 500
Rats - 2000 total, in batches of 500
Fiends - 800 total, in batches of 200
Verliokas - 800 total, in batches of 200
Jellies - 800 total, in batches of 200
Brutors - 800 total, in batches of 200
Blyaks - 400 total, in batches of 100
Basilisks - 400 total, in batches of 100
Sorcerers - 400 total, in batches of 100
Worms - 400 total, in batches of 100


You will get rewards for each batch (rations, injectors, grenades, ammo), and for the total required amount - 10 lottery tickets.

After each 10 mutants killed, you will get notifications in the game chat (In rare cases, the notifications may be missed, but this will not affect your rewards). If you kill the first batch of mutants A, and then the first batch of mutants B (for example, 500 pups and 100 blyaks) - you get two identical rewards for both batches.

If you are done killing all the mutants, the quest will restart.
If you did not manage to kill all the mutants, just wait for the next similar event and pick up where you left off.

We are planning to expand this activity mechanics to other things, like artifacts. Stay tuned for more news! We are also planning to add new rating tables to our site, so you can conveniently watch your progress and compare it to your friends'.

notes.title: Stalker Claus
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/c6c84a64b4a7c40b58b66f40c437342d30c2b620.jpg[/img]
A classified note from the Military offciers:

Sightings of some weird creatures were registered. The creatures's names are almost identical: Дед_Мороз in the Zone sector known by code name "Ru" and Grandfather_Frost in the sectors known as Steam PVE and Steam PVP. The names may have variations such as Дед_Мороз2, Grandfather_Frost2 etc. Our agent attempted to contact them and this is what he reports:

- The creatures are immune to any kind of effects and any weapons
- They do not accept any trade offers
- Their speech and behaviour suggests that they are human beings, or very good copies thereof
- They appear in random spots of the Zone, drop to the ground various items that can be used by stalkers and disappear
- Note: Looks like all of them belong to the same clan called "KM". What does it mean? Kilometers? Killer Mutants? Our deciphering department is still working on that question.

Our secret service agent suggested that those creatures may be one of the embodiments of the so-called "Masters of the Zone". However, we suspect he used way too much vodka to draw out radiation, so he shouldn't be trusted that easily. For now, we carry on with the observations...

notes.title: Update 1.5.7.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3a09d46aceb67d686a47ffeb72925b581a09bea9.png[/img]

- The game engine has been completely ported to the x64 platform and a new version of the C++ compiler, which means that stability has improved, the problem of crashes due to lack of client memory has been solved. This is only one of the reasons for crashes, in future updates we will continue to eliminate other reasons.
- The distribution of game resources by archives has been changed to speed up client loading via the launcher, the performance and stability of the launcher have been improved, and updates are now downloaded faster.
- Added full-screen mode in a frameless window.
- New tutorial mechanisms have been developed for new players, the tutorial location has been redesigned.
- Weapons for pins have been moved to the exchanger of the Changer.
- New types of injectors have been added to the Bookmaker in exchange: experimental Hellcat, Brusnikovka, Ryabinovka. Their characteristics are 20% superior to the enhanced versions of injectors.
- The metal detector (PMD) has been reworked, it is now possible to turn the device on and off.
- The respawn at the "Mental Hospital" base has been fixed, the character no longer falls into the textures.
- The time for capturing bases has been changed, now captures will occur at 21:00 Moscow time: Sawmill and Sanatorium (Lubetch Forestland) daily, Tunguska (1-4) on Wednesdays and Saturdays, Mental Hospital, House on the Hill, Chemical Waste Base (Lubetch Forestland) on Wednesdays and Saturdays, Distillery (Vesuvius) on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, Caravan on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays.
- A rollback has been added for turning in daily quests for the Wanderer.
- Revised tier 5 weapon characteristics.
- Updated Fmod sound engine.
- Integrated in-game Chromium web browser.
- Identical items in the Warehouse can now be stacked together.
- New CA MERCY/SLAVS/STORM have been introduced into the game.
- Fixed the 2nd CA "Bandos".

notes.title: New Patch 1.5.7. is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3a09d46aceb67d686a47ffeb72925b581a09bea9.png[/img]

UPD: As of 11:40 Moscow time, the servers are still working and will continue to work for some time. Preparations for installation are already underway, so don't panic!

--

Stalkers! Attention!

An increase in abnormal activity has been detected in the Zone! A patch is coming!

Tomorrow morning (Moscow time), the game servers will be stopped to install the update. What awaits us on the other side?

- The game engine has been completely ported to the x64 platform and a new version of the C++ compiler, which means that stability has improved, the problem of crashes due to lack of client memory has been solved. This is only one of the reasons for crashes, in future updates we will continue to eliminate other reasons.
- The distribution of game resources by archives has been changed to speed up client loading via the launcher, the performance and stability of the launcher have been improved, and updates are now downloaded faster.
- Added full-screen mode in a frameless window.
- New tutorial mechanisms have been developed for new players, the tutorial location has been redesigned.
- Weapons for pins have been moved to the exchanger of the Changer.
- New types of injectors have been added to the Bookmaker in exchange: experimental Hellcat, Brusnikovka, Ryabinovka. Their characteristics are 20% superior to the enhanced versions of injectors.
- The metal detector (PMD) has been reworked, it is now possible to turn the device on and off.
- The respawn at the "Mental Hospital" base has been fixed, the character no longer falls into the textures.
- The time for capturing bases has been changed, now captures will occur at 21:00 Moscow time: Sawmill and Sanatorium (Lubetch Forestland) daily, Tunguska (1-4) on Wednesdays and Saturdays, Mental Hospital, House on the Hill, Chemical Waste Base (Lubetch Forestland) on Wednesdays and Saturdays, Distillery (Vesuvius) on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, Caravan on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays.
- A rollback has been added for turning in daily quests for the Wanderer.
- Revised tier 5 weapon characteristics.
- Updated Fmod sound engine.
- Integrated in-game Chromium web browser.
- Identical items in the Warehouse can now be stacked together.
- New CA MERCY/SLAVS/STORM have been introduced into the game.
- Fixed the 2nd CA "Bandos".

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzRa_1n0t6s&ab_channel=AnomalyZone

notes.title: “Video Zone 2023” Competitions!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3fab013a757adb47ec87faadefb11af27e930076.jpg[/img]

Stalkers!

Two competitions for the best video about Anomaly Zone (on a free topic) are being held in the next month!


Competition No. 1. The best short video on YouTube Shorts!

Create your own channel (if you don't have one) and post a short video about Anomaly Zone (on YouTube Shorts).

To become a participant in the competition, fulfill two simple conditions:

1. Leave a link to your video in the comments to this ad in the official VK group:

https://vk.com/sz_anomaly_zone?w=wall-16130329_432435


2. (IMPORTANT!) In the description of the video (on YouTube Shorts) that you want to submit for the competition, there must be a link to the website of the game itself: https://anomaly-zone.net/?lang=en

The winners are determined by the largest number of views during the month (from the current date to December 17 inclusive).


Competition No. 2. Best video about Anomaly Zone!

Any duration (within reason). This time the winners will be determined by the Anomaly Zone development team, so the video should NOT be published on public platforms. Send it through file exchangers (“Yandex Disk”, “Cloud Mail.ru” or any other) to our official e-mail:

info@cybertime-system.com

We will publish the winners' videos ourselves after the competition ends.

The dates are the same, from the current date to December 17 inclusive.


Prizes

Based on the results, the top three, separately for each competition (three winners of competition No. 1 and three winners of competition No. 2), will receive bonuses to their game account, which they are then free to dispose of at their own discretion.

1st place: 6000 rub.

2nd place: 4000 rub.

3rd place: 2000 rub.

Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/57eb049b8a4719a901fb27df1641ab6273d6194e.jpg[/img]

From 00:00 on 22.05 till 23:59 on 23.05 (Moscow time) win as many times as you can on Arenas.

Three winners from each server (RU, PvP, PvE), who have get the most wins, will receive prizes:

"Bobik" Armor Vest (pers., 30 days)
RGO Frag Grenade - 10 pcs.
Injector with Purified "Hellcat" - 10 pcs.

In addition, any participant from RU server will receive 50 "A-Zone" pins for every 100 wins, while any participant from PvE and PvP servers will get 25 "A-Zone" pins for every 50 wins.

Good luck!

notes.title: Pins for Spiders!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/10a6c59982d6ecb101c5086a6e74b4bd003b536b.jpg[/img]

From 00:00 - 15.05 till 23:59 - 16.05 (Moscow time) - defeat regular (not rare or "killer" class) spiders.
 
To get points you need to hunt mutants, whose killing brings you more than 5 EXP.

Any participant from main servers (RU, PvP, PvE), who get into top-15, will receive 40 A-Zone pins.

Good luck!

notes.title: PPS for Victory Day!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/8b4b2f3a1837780aaf0a39565346e302474d1e92.jpg[/img]

Congratulate veterans of the Zone and win "PPS for Victory Day"!
 
In Zone find NPC with the May quest, get a bouquet of carnations and the "Strong Medicine", receive the submachine gun as a reward, use it as intended.
 
Festive PPS active for one day only, but you can repeat the quest of any veteran at least every hour. Quests are available until 12:00 by Moscow time on May 11.

notes.title: Happy Holidays
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/e16902660de65256c9a47c5086654b247aafa812.png[/img]

The Hunters faction call to unite and clean the Anomalous Zone out of mutants! Five days of continuous hunting with separate prizes. Eliminate as many mutants as you can to get to the first lines of the top (on one of three main servers: RU, PvP, PvE). New goal every day (from 00:00 till 23:59, by Moscow time):
 
1 May - Rats
2 May - Hogs
3 May - Verliokas
4 May - Brutors
5 May - Sorcerers
6 May - Bears
7 May - Blyaks
8 May - Jellies
9 May - Basilisks
10 May - Fiends

The first 15 hunters in the tops of every day will get 40 A-Zone pins!

Random SUPERPRIZES will be drawn between those participants who show themselves in several hunts at once (i.e., will take high places and will participate for several days), but no more than one prize in one hand:

1. Full set of "SBZ" without time restrictions:
SBZ Armor Vest
SBZ Jacket
SBZ Pants
SBZ Mask
SBZ Hood
SBZ Gloves
SBZ Boots

2. SBZ Complete Set (60 days) in Box (60 days)

3. "Seven Years" Complete Set (60 days) in Box (60 days)

4. "Night Wolf" Backpack (30 days)

5. Artifact "Piedmont Brutor Whistle" (60 days)

6. Artifact "Bear's Whistle" (24 days) to call a bear in ushanka-hat

7. Artifact "Verlioka's Cube" (24 days)

8. Artifact "Mischief α"

9. Spider Helmet Filter

10. Ezotery

We remind you that only those mutants are taken into account, which brought more than 5 experience points.
 
The winners will be announced and the prizes will be distributed after the holidays (after the 10th May).
 
Have a good hunting!

notes.title: Video Nostalgia Competition!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/3fab013a757adb47ec87faadefb11af27e930076.jpg[/img]

Stalkers!

The end of the year (and the year, to put it mildly, turned out to be tense) - it's time to take stock!

Before moving on, we suggest looking back, assessing the path traveled and remembering the impressions that our project gave.

To do this, we are announcing a video competition, and this time you are not limited to the "New Year" or "winter" themes. Any videos about the Anomaly Zone game are considered, you are not constrained by either the topic or the length (within reason; it is still recommended to stay in the range from 1 to 6-10 minutes, depending on the content of your video; remember that the longer the videos, the longer it will take to look through them, determining the winners).

Maybe you decide to make an atmospheric video? Or a full-fledged video review of strengths / weaknesses, with fair criticism? Do you want to show a funny incident from the life of stalkers? Survive an encounter with monsters? Arrange a PvP battle in arenas or during the base capture?

Put the videos on YouTube, leave links under the news [url=https://vk.com/sz_anomaly_zone]in our VK group.[/url]

All standard general restrictions on a content apply (no insults, no pornography, no drug propaganda, no incitement to hatred, etc .; YouTube will not let this either). The rest is complete freedom for creativity.

Works are accepted until [b]January 10, 2021 inclusive[/b]. Depending on the number of participants, it will take several weeks for the jury to select the five best videos. Links to the selected works will be published on the website, in the news on Steam and in the VK group.

[b]The winners will receive a prize item (without time restrictions) and a nice bonus on their personal account, depending on the occupied place:[/b]

[b]1 place:[/b]
SBZ Full Set and 5,000 rub.

[b]2 place:[/b]
"Seven Years" Full Set and 4,000 rub.

[b]3 place:[/b]
"Four Stars" Beret and 3,000 rub.

[b]4 place:[/b]
"Night Wolf" Backpack and 2,000 rub.

[b]5 place:[/b]
Gyurza Backpack and 1,000 rub.

Good luck!

The White Bear is a rare beast that is interesting to both hunters and scientists. It is found mainly in Novaya Zemlya (Terra Nova), where it hides against the backdrop of snowy plains and forests due to the color of its fur. It is a dangerous, aggressive mutant of the Zone. A real challenge for professional clan.

From 00:00 on 06.06.20 till 23:59 on 06.07.20 (by Moscow time), find and kill the White Bear. The stalker (on RU, PvP or PvE server) who killed the largest number of white bears in the allotted days wins.

To get points you need to hunt mutants, whose killing brings you more than 5 EXP.

[b]ATTENTION![/b] If there are more than one winner (i.e. several stalkers killed the same number of white bears), the rewards will be shared between ALL winning players (namely, divided by the number of winners). Rewards DO NOT multiply if the number of winners is more than one, which means that the fewer the winners, the more prizes will go into one hand.

notes.title: Event "Great Jelly Hunters"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35864315/2528c875ab68199e51f0b037007b21c52d1c46a5.jpg[/img]

In one of the Zone places the Hunters discovered a large cluster of mutants, which will soon pose a huge threat to the hunter camp in the Tunguska swamps. Requests for help were sent to all stalkers of the Zone.

31.05.2020, from 15:00 to 17:00 (by Moscow time), clear the Zone from the usual (not rare, not "killers") mutant jellies. Any help is appreciated anywhere in the Zone, however, the hunters report that they saw jellies at the Tunguska location, D4 square, and the near swamps.

To get points you need to hunt mutants, whose killing brings you more than 5 EXP.

To win shoot most jelly mutants in the allotted time.

Rewards:

1 place: Vepr-12 Shotgun
2 place: Cynologist Suit (S-Camo) (without timer)
3 place: Box of Humanitarian Aid - 10 pcs.

Any stalker from main servers (RU, PvP, PvE), who get into top-30 and defeat more than 10 jellies, will receive 20 A-Zone pins.

Once again the Hunters of Zone asks you to live in peace with your fellow stalker and to hunt only mutants.
